items.title: ElevenLabs Eleven Realtime v1 Mini and Max speech-to-speech agent models
items.summary: ElevenLabs launched two speech-to-speech models that bundle ASR, turn-taking, an LLM and TTS into one system. Mini (about 620ms to first audio) targets conversational use such as tutors; Max (about 570ms) reasons before replying. Both cover 90+ languages and are exposed through ElevenAgents and an OpenAI Realtime-compatible API.
items.whyItMatters: Anna already runs on ElevenLabs, and an OpenAI Realtime-compatible endpoint could let Romain's pipeline swap to Mini for cost or voice-quality tests with little code change; French accent handling is worth benchmarking.

items.title: OpenAI makes its Decisions API model widely available
items.summary: OpenAI opened its fast decision model to all customers, a rival to TypeSafe's Jev. It cuts inference time from 1-3 seconds to roughly 100-180ms.
items.whyItMatters: A cheap, sub-200ms classifier could handle tutor-side routing, such as detecting when to correct a learner or switch topic, without slowing the voice loop.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, a background agent app built on Opus 5.5
items.summary: Duet is an agent app for professionals and small businesses that works in the background, builds briefings and dashboards, and connects to thousands of Claude Marketplace plug-ins. It is waitlisted for Pro and Max users on iOS, Android and web.
items.whyItMatters: Worth knowing as a signal of where agent products are heading; the proactive background-monitoring pattern could inspire tutor features like unprompted review nudges.

items.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US federal restrictions
items.summary: DeepSeek reportedly raised about $15 billion from investors including CATL and Tencent, two days after the US ordered federal agencies to remove its technology.
items.whyItMatters: Heavy new funding suggests continued cheap open-weight model releases, which could push LLM costs down for the tutor backend.
